name: Numaya illustration catalog
notIllustrations: Profile photos (dynamic content: the Match portrait, cards, avatars)
Navigation and utility icons (Material Symbols Rounded)
Profile readiness meter and progress bars (data components)
Activity and Home photo placeholders (photography, not illustration)

placements.region: Below the supporting copy, above the message composer; centred, full content width up to 320px

illustrations.purpose: The match moment itself: two people meeting halfway and making something together.
illustrations.art: Two hands entering from the left and right edges, meeting in the centre to form a heart with fingers and thumbs. Friendly, slightly stylised (not photoreal), one hand wearing a couple of rings, the other a bracelet or watch. The heart shape should read at 120px tall. Arms may bleed off the left and right edges of the canvas.
illustrations.palette: White or transparent ground; near-black (#141316) outlines; brand purple #7262C7 as the one strong accent; lavender #F3F0FD / #E9E4FB for soft fills; Meetup periwinkle, yellow and rose only as small marks. Skin tones: a warm and a cool tone so the hands read as two different people.
illustrations.safeMargin: Heart centred with 12% clear space above and below; arms may touch the left and right edges.
illustrations.shadows: None in the artwork; the UI adds none either.
illustrations.animation: Planned: hands slide in from the edges and meet to form the heart (separate layers for each hand and accessory in the source file).

placements.region: The whole lavender hero above the headline panel; square, centred, up to 320px

illustrations.purpose: First impression: Numaya is about conversation and first dates, not endless swiping.
illustrations.art: A multi-element composition: two abstract people meeting over a shared conversation (a prompt card or speech bubble between them), with a couple of small date-night props (coffee cups, a record). Inclusive, ungendered, faces simplified.
illustrations.palette: White or transparent ground; near-black (#141316) outlines; brand purple #7262C7 as the one strong accent; lavender #F3F0FD / #E9E4FB for soft fills; Meetup periwinkle, yellow and rose only as small marks.
illustrations.safeMargin: 8% clear on every side; the composition shrinks with the hero's free height, so keep the focal point central.
illustrations.transparency: Transparent PNG over the lavender wash.
illustrations.shadows: Soft ground shadow allowed inside the artwork.
illustrations.animation: Optional: gentle float or staggered reveal of elements.

illustrations.purpose: Confirms the phone number is verified and the person is ready to build a profile.
illustrations.art: A phone showing a just-arrived message with a check, or a hand holding a phone with a small burst of confirmation. Calm, confident, a little celebratory.
illustrations.palette: White or transparent ground; near-black (#141316) outlines; brand purple #7262C7 as the one strong accent; lavender #F3F0FD / #E9E4FB for soft fills; Meetup periwinkle, yellow and rose only as small marks.

illustrations.purpose: No conversations yet: matches lead here, and this is where chatting starts.
illustrations.art: A speech bubble with typing dots waiting for a reply, or two benches facing each other with a path between them.
illustrations.palette: White or transparent ground; near-black (#141316) outlines; brand purple #7262C7 as the one strong accent; lavender #F3F0FD / #E9E4FB for soft fills; Meetup periwinkle, yellow and rose only as small marks.

placements.screen: It’s a match: no new match yet

illustrations.purpose: Interest is on its way: nothing yet, but connections are coming. One asset serves both empty states.
illustrations.art: Two paper planes (or two small hearts) on curving paths heading towards each other, not yet met.

illustrations.purpose: No activities yet: invite people to join one or host their own.
illustrations.art: A small calendar page or event ticket with a few friendly objects around it (a coffee cup, walking shoes, a record), suggesting plans waiting to happen.

illustrations.purpose: You’re caught up: new people arrive every day, no pressure.
illustrations.art: A small fanned stack of profile cards with the front one face-down or blank, or an open door with soft light: more to come tomorrow.
illustrations.palette: White or transparent ground; near-black (#141316) outlines; brand purple #7262C7 as the one strong accent; lavender #F3F0FD / #E9E4FB for soft fills; Meetup periwinkle, yellow and rose only as small marks.

illustrations.purpose: A conversation has ended. Neutral and calm: no blame, no celebration.
illustrations.art: Two speech bubbles drifting apart, or a closed notebook. Quiet, simple, respectful.
illustrations.palette: Neutrals only (#141316 ink, greys #E9E8EB–#8A8A90) with at most a faint lavender wash; no purple accent, no sparkles: this is a safety outcome, not a celebration.
